assets.prompt:
[FORMAT]
Wide 16:9 editorial studio banner composition.
[FOCAL SUBJECT]
Four industrial sewing thread cones in rust terracotta, warm cream, dark navy, and muted ochre, grouped asymmetrically with rust cone at the right third as strongest focal anchor, cones occupying about 65 percent of frame width. Faithfully follow the observed form: tall softly tapering truncated cones, fine densely wound slightly lustrous fibers with diagonal cross-winding bands, broad round base, gently rounded thread shoulder, small bright yellow hollow plastic tube protruding from the center at the top and a thin yellow base lip. No paper wrap or labels. Industrial sewing-thread scale, not yarn balls and not chunky rope. Three upright cones and one cream cone resting horizontally naturally supported on folded fabric.
[COMPOSITION]
Sculptural but physically grounded arrangement, staggered heights and gaps, on pale cool limestone surface. An off-white folded natural woven fabric crosses the foreground diagonally, modest material crease and visible weave. Every cone rests with believable contact shadows, no levitation. Background is a continuing pale cool stone studio plane. Maintain subject crop safety in central field and an intentional horizontal rhythm without reserved text bands.
[ATMOSPHERE]
Quiet refined tactile studio still life, clear air, natural material presence, slightly imperfect woven surface.
[LIGHTING]
Large soft window source from 45 degrees camera-left, directional 5200K daylight with subtle bounced fill, soft gradient shadow falloff to right, shaded fiber grooves, restrained highlights on tightly wound thread.
[LENS & CAMERA]
50mm standard lens, f/8, medium-deep depth of field keeping thread winding legible across all cone faces; eye level just above surface, looking gently downward, natural perspective.
[COLOR PALETTE]
Rust terracotta and cool pale stone dominate, warm cream, deep navy and a modest muted ochre accent; rich but restrained tonal range.
[STYLE REFERENCE]
Classical still-life balance with asymmetric geometric staging, color-blocked sculptural product forms, soft natural light and tactile surfaces. Restrained editorial commercial photography, photographic material irregularity and subtle grain.
[QUALITY MARKERS]
Magazine-cover quality, tack-sharp commercial photography, hyper-detailed photorealistic rendering, editorial commercial standard, ultra-realistic textures and materials, professional retouching standard.
[AVOID]

Wide 16:9 editorial textile application banner, a new extreme closeup scene using the referenced image only to preserve the rust industrial sewing thread's fiber texture and palette, not its framing.
[FOCAL SUBJECT]
Believable fine rust terracotta sewing thread in two neat straight parallel rows of lockstitch along a turned seam in undyed warm cream woven linen-cotton fabric. Seam detail runs diagonally through center-right, visible individual thread fibers and small consistent needle entry points. A softly out-of-focus cropped section of the same rust industrial cone appears at the far upper-left as an understated source cue, preserving its dense cross-wound fibers and tapered profile, with no labels. Sewing thread is fine relative to fabric weave, not chunky embroidery yarn or rope.
[COMPOSITION]
Close oblique view of a folded textile swatch on pale cool limestone studio surface. The stitched seam is focal anchor at right third, occupies 60 percent frame width. One naturally curved loose tail of thread lies lightly near the seam. Strong diagonal flow, clear foreground-to-background separation, physical fabric edges and weave, no visible underside or cutaway, simple authentic sewing sample. Compose a coherent rich horizontal scene without blank text bands.

Quiet premium tactile studio, modest natural weave irregularities, calm and precise craft.
